reason: I travel a lot and always leave my pills at home, so a foil sachet with my 2 capsules already counted that I can toss in my gym bag actually fits. The lab report behind the QR code and the empty-box guarantee make one box at $24.99 an easy thing to try.
objection: Two capsules every day is still a chore, and I will forget to take them some evenings. If I do not finish the 30 sachets, the guarantee does not help me, and I am not sure I would feel any difference.
